description_en: Queries the log storage version, delivery mode, storage quota, site-specific destinations, and the status of the latest change task. Call this operation before updating configurations. When Sites is empty, use Version and TaskStatus together to determine the current configuration and provisioning progress
description_zh: 查询日志存储版本、投递模式、存储配额、各站点目的地及最新变更任务状态。更新配置前可先读取本接口；Sites 为空时，应结合 Version 和 TaskStatus 判断当前配置及开通进度
name: DescribeDeliveryDestination

Data.description_en: The log delivery destinations and task status
Data.description_zh: 日志投递目的地及任务状态

DeliveryMode.description_en: The log delivery mode. single_site indicates single-site delivery. multi_site indicates multi-site delivery. This field may be empty if the feature is not activated
DeliveryMode.description_zh: 日志投递模式。single_site 表示单站点，multi_site 表示多站点；未开通时可能为空

ModeSwitchInfo.description_en: The monthly quota for switching between single-site and multi-site modes for the new log storage version. This field may be empty if not applicable
ModeSwitchInfo.description_zh: 新版日志存储的本月单站点与多站点模式切换配额；不适用时可能为空

AvailableTimes.description_en: The remaining number of mode switches available in the current month. Pending, in-progress, and successful mode switch tasks all consume the quota. Failed tasks do not consume the quota
AvailableTimes.description_zh: 本月剩余可切换次数。待执行、执行中及已成功的模式切换任务均占用次数，失败任务不占用

Sites.description_en: The list of configured log delivery sites. This field is empty if the feature is not activated or site configurations have not been created
Sites.description_zh: 已配置的日志投递站点列表；未开通或尚未形成站点配置时为空

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the Simple Log Service destination
Endpoint.description_zh: 日志服务目的地的访问域名

Logstore.description_en: The Logstore name of the Simple Log Service destination
Logstore.description_zh: 日志服务目的地的 Logstore 名称

Project.description_en: The project name of the Simple Log Service destination
Project.description_zh: 日志服务目的地的 Project 名称

Region.description_en: The region ID of the Simple Log Service destination
Region.description_zh: 日志服务目的地的地域 ID

Site.description_en: The site identifier. global indicates unified single-site delivery. cn indicates the China site. intl indicates the international site. gov indicates the Alibaba Gov Cloud site
Site.description_zh: 站点标识。global 表示单站点统一投递；cn、intl、gov 分别表示中国站、国际站和政务云站点

SlsStatus.description_en: The status of the Simple Log Service destination. Valid values: 0: active. 1: quota exceeded. 2: resource does not exist
SlsStatus.description_zh: 日志服务目的地状态。0 表示可用，1 表示超出限制，2 表示资源不存在

SlsStatusDesc.description_en: The status description of the Simple Log Service destination. Valid values: Available: active. ExceedLimit: quota exceeded. NotExist: resource does not exist
SlsStatusDesc.description_zh: 日志服务目的地状态说明。Available 表示可用，ExceedLimit 表示超出限制，NotExist 表示资源不存在

SpaceQuota.description_en: The log storage quota for the site. Unit: bytes
SpaceQuota.description_zh: 该站点的日志存储配额，单位为字节

TTL.description_en: The log retention period for the site. Unit: days
TTL.description_zh: 该站点日志的保存天数

TaskStatus.description_en: The latest change task for the new log storage version. This field may be empty if no task records exist
TaskStatus.description_zh: 新版日志存储的最新变更任务；无任务记录时可能为空

OpType.description_en: The task operation type. Valid values: CREATE: create. UPDATE: update. DELETE: delete
OpType.description_zh: 任务操作类型。CREATE 表示创建，UPDATE 表示更新，DELETE 表示删除

Status.description_en: The task execution status. Valid values: 0: pending. 1: in progress. 2: succeeded. 3: failed
Status.description_zh: 任务执行状态。0 表示待执行，1 表示执行中，2 表示成功，3 表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the latest log storage change task
TaskId.description_zh: 最新日志存储变更任务的 ID

TotalQuota.description_en: The total purchased log storage quota. Unit: bytes
TotalQuota.description_zh: 已购买的日志存储总配额，单位为字节

Version.description_en: The log storage version. Valid values: 0: legacy version. 2: new version. The version number alone does not indicate that provisioning is complete
Version.description_zh: 日志存储规格版本。0 表示旧版，2 表示新版；版本号本身不代表已完成开通

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This field is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This field describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true: The request was successful. false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
